title: Manufacturing Carpentry Associate
description:
Manufacturing Carpentry Associate (Will Train!) – $18-$22/hr + Overtime

Location: New Haven, CT
Pay: $18.00-$22.00 per hour, based on experience
Schedule: Full-Time | Day Shift | Overtime Available

Are you looking for a hands-on manufacturing career with a growing company? Our client, an established manufacturer with over 45 years of success, is looking for motivated individuals to join their production team. If you're dependable, enjoy working with your hands, and have manufacturing experience, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

  • Cut, trim, and sand carbon fiber materials

  • Assist with the assembly of boat components using molds

  • Work with epoxy adhesives following safety guidelines

  • Use hand tools, utility knives, measuring tapes, and DA sanders

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

  • Follow all company safety and quality procedures

What We're Looking For:

  • Previous manufacturing or production experience required

  • Composite or carbon fiber experience is a plus, but not required

  • Willingness to learn and be trained

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

  • Able to stand, walk, bend, lift, and carry materials throughout an 8-hour shift

  • Reliable transportation to New Haven, CT

Why You'll Love This Opportunity:

  • Competitive pay: $18.00-$22.00 per hour

  • Overtime opportunities

  • Paid, hands-on training

  • Stable, full-time position with a growing manufacturer

  • Opportunity to develop valuable skills in composite manufacturing

Benefits Include:

  • 401(k)

  • Health Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Paid Time Off

  • Retirement Plan

  • On-the-Job Training

Requirements:

  • English proficiency required

  • Day shift availability

  • Driver's License preferred

  • Must be able to commute to New Haven, CT

If you're looking for a company that values hard work, provides training, and offers room to grow, apply today!
